features.name: Structured Requirement Decomposition & Falsification Analysis
preconditions: User submits valid product vision and pain point descriptions through the ingestion API
All mandatory project metadata slots (name, target users, market segment) are non-empty
postconditions: System generates formal 5W1H requirement specification conforming strictly to ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 standards
All identified user pain points are grounded to verifiable business invariants and negative defense scenarios
business_rules: Every requirement statement must employ RFC 2119 normative keywords (MUST, SHALL, SHOULD, MAY) with unambiguous testability.
Demand falsification must evaluate market demand against willingness-to-pay thresholds before greenlighting PRD authoring.
Explicit Non-Goals inventory must specify boundary reasons explaining why out-of-scope items are rejected.

comprehensive_prd.summary: Comprehensive PRD specifying architecture, state machine transitions, exception recovery, tracking telemetry, and non-functional guarantees for Aurakl Sentinel.

state_invariants.formal_rule: Once OrderEntity reaches the terminal SETTLED state, it must NEVER reverse to DRAFT or SUBMITTED
state_invariants.violation_consequence: Causes completed transactions to be modified or double-settled, leading to direct financial loss

data_integrity_invariants.conservation_rule: The sum of all sub-account allocated amounts must strictly equal the total transaction amount (sum(sub_amounts) == total_amount)
data_integrity_invariants.violation_consequence: Allocation discrepancies trigger statutory financial audit violations and reconciliation failures

security_and_privacy_invariants.isolation_rule: Requests from Tenant A must NEVER access, read, or modify invariant rules or metadata belonging to Tenant B under any execution context
security_and_privacy_invariants.violation_consequence: Cross-tenant data breaches and privilege escalation violating data privacy regulations

ux_and_safety_invariants.safety_rule: Any destructive operation deleting rules or purging audit history must require explicit secondary confirmation and a 30-day recoverable recycle bin
ux_and_safety_invariants.violation_consequence: Accidental deletion resulting in permanent, unrecoverable loss of historical compliance audit trails

scenarios.scenario_title: Order state successfully transitions forward to settled
scenarios.given: Order is in SUBMITTED state and payment is confirmed
scenarios.then: Order status is atomically updated to SETTLED and transaction is recorded

scenarios.scenario_title: Defend against illegal reverse state transition to draft
scenarios.given: Order is in terminal SETTLED state
scenarios.when: API call attempts to mutate status to DRAFT
scenarios.then: System rejects mutation with EXC_ILLEGAL_STATE_TRANSITION and status remains SETTLED

scenarios.scenario_title: Validate allocation sum conservation on valid transaction
scenarios.given: Total ledger amount is 100 with sub-allocations of 60 and 40
scenarios.then: Validation passes and transaction is recorded in ledger

scenarios.scenario_title: Defend against illegal allocation requests violating conservation
scenarios.given: Total ledger amount is 100 with sub-allocations of 60 and 50 (sum = 110)
scenarios.then: System immediately rejects entry and triggers balance discrepancy alert

scenarios.scenario_title: Defend against cross-tenant unauthorized access to rules
scenarios.given: Authentication context belongs to Tenant A
scenarios.when: Attempting to query invariant rules belonging to Tenant B via API
scenarios.then: System returns 403 Forbidden and records security access violation log

scenarios.scenario_title: Deleting invariant rules requires explicit secondary confirmation
scenarios.given: User clicks delete invariant rule button
scenarios.when: Secondary confirmation dialog is dismissed without confirmation
scenarios.then: Rule remains active and deletion is not executed
